top_posts.text: New trial of gene editing therapy: A one-time intravenous infusion of CTX310, a CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing therapy targeting hepatic ANGPTL3, produced substantial reductions in ANGPTL3 and serum triglycerides at 30 days in participants with severe hypertriglyceridemia, providing evidence of durable target knockdown and lipid-lowering efficacy. Download slides here: https://lnkd.in/gFPr8BgD
top_posts.summary: CTX310 gene editing reduced ANGPTL3 and triglycerides at 30 days in severe hypertriglyceridemia.

top_posts.text: Dr. Ashish Saraju and Dr. C. Michael Gibson discuss the phase 1b study of severe hypertriglyceridemia: A single dose of CTX310, an investigational CRISPR-Cas9 therapy targeting ANGPTL3, achieved a mean triglyceride reduction of 63% from baseline at 30 days in patients with severe hypertriglyceridemia, diabetes, and ASCVD, demonstrating preliminary clinical efficacy and a favorable safety profile.
top_posts.summary: CTX310 CRISPR ANGPTL3 therapy cut triglycerides 63% at 30 days in severe hypertriglyceridemia.
